description.subtitle: Short pants of the first adidas equipment of Liverpool 2026 2027 - red
description.tagline: El estilo Liverpool con comodidad y rendimiento
description.intro: The Liverpool 26 27 short adidas combines the classic essence of Liverpool FC with modern details inspired by the club’s historic equipments during the eighties. Designed for fans who live football with passion, it offers comfort, lightness and freedom of movement.
key_benefits: CLIMACOOL: Mantiene el cuerpo fresco y seco durante el juego.
Elastic waistband with cord: Safe and customizable fit.
Light fabric: Facilitates mobility in each action.
Official design: Inspired by the Liverpool 26/27 equipment.
